findings.observation: Same update_id and text_hash with changed message_id, chat_id and user_id is accepted as the original record. Rejected updates also return an existing row without checking collision identity.
findings.fix: Bind canonical bot/request identity plus full immutable envelope identity/digest. Idempotency requires complete equality, including rejection tombstones; changed identity must refuse unchanged.
findings.falsifier: Existing update100; replay same text hash with message888/chat9999/user999 must return collision.

findings.observation: Watermark100 with [new101, conflicting100] returns watermark102 and one collision. Input order is trusted, so acknowledgement can skip the failed lower update.
findings.fix: Validate whole batch ordering and duplicate consistency before advancing any prefix, or normalize deterministically with collision prevalidation. Keep integer gaps legal; never acknowledge past a failed presented update.
findings.falsifier: Descending batch above must refuse without advancing beyond unresolved100; repeat across nonadjacent duplicate/collision positions.

findings.observation: Every InboxProcessing becomes InboxPending even when outbox is delivered. The record has no request_id/result linkage to correlate output. Recovered inbox can be claimed by a new worker. Supplied restart test asserts unconditional reset.
findings.fix: Persist explicit request/result/outbox linkage and recovery disposition. Existing durable results resume only delivery reconciliation; delivered or uncertain results cannot re-execute. Missing/inconsistent linkage holds rather than silently requeues.
findings.falsifier: Crash snapshots with PENDING/SENDING/DELIVERED/UNCERTAIN chunks and matching request must not create a second result/send attempt; mixed unrelated requests remain isolated.

findings.observation: Wrong worker for a sending chunk rewrites its status to UNCERTAIN; calling reconciliation on delivered chunk overwrites DELIVERED with UNCERTAIN. Refused authority changes state.
findings.fix: Return Result and preserve original state on nonmatching request/worker/epoch or invalid prior state. Only matching current SENDING may consume its corresponding outcome.
findings.falsifier: Wrong owner/epoch/request and terminal replay return error with state unchanged; matching send mismatch may become UNCERTAIN.

findings.observation: /tool query_doctor {"path":"/etc"} and /action query_saplan garbage both become argument-free DirectReadTool. Denial text also suggests an available /approval workflow although it is unimplemented.
findings.fix: Validate exact command grammar and optional empty JSON object explicitly; refuse blank/nonobject/nonempty arguments instead of discarding. State unsupported mutation/approval behavior truthfully.
findings.falsifier: Valid no-arg/empty-object forms accepted; supplied malformed/nonempty examples refused; no denial advertises an implemented approval path.

findings.function: ledger constructors/claims and ingress identity validation
findings.observation: Empty worker and epoch0 can claim and complete with empty digest; invalid empty request_id/index-1/total0/chat0/payload4097 and epoch-1 can be sent; ingestion accepts1001 pending rows. Channel chat with allowed numeric from is accepted; allowlist.bot_id has no effect and is not carried in envelope.
findings.fix: Use checked constructors/opaque validated inputs and explicit documented limits: nonempty owner/request, positive epoch, digest shape, valid chunk count/index/payload and queue cap. Validate required numeric identity fields/chat kind. Carry trusted observed bot identity into envelope/ledger or explicitly document single-bot external binding without claiming guard authentication.
findings.falsifier: Boundary and boundary+1 tests, empty/negative identity/epoch tests, channel variants, cross-bot same update ID. Queue-full refusal must preserve offset.
